catalog.data.gov.reason: The legacy CKAN endpoint returns HTTP 404 because Data.gov migrated to its v4 Catalog API. The replacement requires a free personal API key; DEMO_KEY is explicitly unsuitable for automated queries. A separate v4 adapter and configured key are required before discovery resumes.

open.canada.ca.policy_note: Apply the Open Government Licence where it is actually attached to the record; federated datasets may carry different terms.

opendata.swiss.policy_note: Official CKAN API documentation supports metadata search. Preserve dataset-level isopen/private/rights and each resource's controlled rights value, attribution and license fields. This adapter is metadata-only and must not fetch bulk resources. Runtime access remains fail-closed on robots.txt and the effective host delay.

data.gov.au.reason: Source terms and dataset-level reuse conditions have not been reviewed.

openlibrary.org.reason: The API is not intended as a bulk-data backend or high-traffic commercial infrastructure; use the official data dumps or obtain permission before bulk harvesting.

frontiersin.org.policy_note: Frontiers Terms and Conditions section 14 permits text and data mining of public content for the legitimate purpose of enriching external collections of scientific literature. Content remains subject to each article's applicable CC-BY, CC0, or other license and applicable data-protection laws. This policy is limited to bounded landing-page discovery of bibliographic metadata; do not retrieve full text, images, supplementary files, or bulk assets. Exact path shapes only: /articles; /journals/{journal}/articles; /journals/{journal}/sections/{section}; /journals/{journal}/sections/{section}/articles. Individual article paths and deeper descendants are not allowlisted. Runtime robots.txt verification on the exact host is mandatory; honor disallowed paths and any performance restrictions.

images-api.nasa.gov.blocked_reason: The NASA API metadata endpoint was reachable, but the preview asset host images-assets.nasa.gov returned HTTP 403 for robots.txt. Thumbnail permission cannot be verified, so the NASA video provider is disabled fail-closed. Do not fetch or display NASA preview assets unless robots access becomes verifiable.
images-api.nasa.gov.policy_note: Reviewed NASA media guidelines. Not used for video search while the preview asset host's robots policy remains unverifiable.

commons.wikimedia.org.policy_note: Use the official Wikimedia Commons API for metadata only. Each video item must pass the per-item CC0, public-domain, CC BY or CC BY-SA license policy, including required creator/credit attribution and canonical license URLs where required. Do not download or re-host video files. Thumbnail URLs are returned to the user's browser only; the backend does not fetch media assets. Commercial eligibility remains false until separate per-item review.
